SLIDE 1: TITLE
Foobar Systems — invoice reconciliation for mid-market logistics

SLIDE 2: PROBLEM
Finance teams at mid-market freight brokers reconcile invoices by hand.
A 40-person brokerage burns 30+ hours/week on it.

SLIDE 3: SOLUTION
Foobar ingests carrier invoices and auto-matches them to load records.

SLIDE 4: MARKET
1 200 000 target businesses worldwide at a $1,200 annual contract value.
Bottom-up TAM: $1,800MM.

SLIDE 5: TRACTION
412 paying customers at an ARPU of $95/month.
MRR of $22K, growing since launch.
Qualified pipeline of $20MM.

SLIDE 6: TEAM
Three founders, ex-Flexport (ops) and two ex-Oracle (eng).

SLIDE 7: ASK
Raising $3M seed at $17M post-money.
